_comment: Snyk Agent Scan risks accepted per skill, with the reason. CI passes these to --ignore-risks for that skill only. Remove an entry when the reason no longer holds.

skills/create-intent.third_party_content_exposure: Reading Jira stories and comments is the skill's job; SKILL.md step 2 treats that text as data, not instructions.

skills/github-sync.third_party_content_exposure: Pulling GitHub issues is the skill's job; SKILL.md treats issue and comment text as data and reports requests to the user.

skills/jira-to-local.third_party_content_exposure: Pulling Jira issues is the skill's job; it is read-only and treats issue text as data.

skills/load-docs.third_party_content_exposure: Loads only URLs the user names; loaded content is treated as data.

skills/trade-off-analysis.third_party_content_exposure: Web research for options is the skill's job; results are evidence, not instructions.

skills/mcp-builder.secret_detection: False positive: Snyk's own redaction of placeholders such as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=your_api_key_here in reference/evaluation.md.

skills/typescript-clean-code.secret_detection: False positive: Snyk's own redaction of a checkPassword example in references/functions/examples.md.

skills/typescript-e2e-testing.secret_detection: False positive: Snyk's own redaction of a local test DATABASE_URL (test:test@localhost) in references/common/rules.md.

skills/typescript-unit-testing.secret_detection: False positive: Snyk's own redaction of an ApiKeyService mock in references/nestjs/guards.md.
